title: BotTurnEndedPayload
description: bot.turn.ended v1 (OpenVibe.Bot server/domain/index.js handedOff). A queue robot's turn ended: its time ran out (turn_ended) or its holder left the line (turn_left). Bot halts the robot before the next turn. It never names the person. Envelope: subject { type: robot, id: <robot id> }, visibility internal, priority normal, actor service:bot.

presses_used.description: The turn's presses (buttons, clicks on the video) spent; driving never counts.
